deep.reconstruction:
Setting: a category C with a class W of weak equivalences and a full subcategory Cof of cofibrant objects, with W_cof = W ∩ Cof. Two assumptions are used. Every object x has a cofibrant replacement α_x : x̃ → x in W, chosen to be the identity when x is already cofibrant. And Brown-type factorizations exist. For f : x → y, the composite f α_x (or x̃ ⊔ ỹ → y) is factored through a cofibrant object ỹ'. This gives f̃ : x̃ → ỹ', i_f : ỹ → ỹ' and a weak equivalence β_f : ỹ' → y, with β_f f̃ = f α_x and β_f i_f = α_y. By 2-out-of-3, i_f ∈ W.

Definition of Φ: Φ(f) = [i_f]^{-1}[f̃] in W_cof^{-1}Cof. The top diagrams (the z̃', z̃'' and g̃, g̃' arrows) check that Φ is compatible with composition g∘f.

W goes to isomorphisms: if f ∈ W, then f α_x ∈ W, so f̃ ∈ W by 2-out-of-3. Hence [f] is an isomorphism, and Φ factors through W^{-1}C.

The two functors Ψ : W_cof^{-1}Cof → W^{-1}C (induced by the inclusion) and Φ : W^{-1}C → W_cof^{-1}Cof are then shown to be quasi-inverse.
- ΦΨ is literally the identity, because α_x = id on cofibrant objects.
- For ΨΦ, by the universal property of localization it suffices to show that R = ΨΦ|C : C → W^{-1}C, x ↦ x̃, is isomorphic to the canonical functor. The candidate isomorphism is [α_x].
- Naturality: [α_y][i_f]^{-1}[f̃] = [β_f i_f][i_f]^{-1}[f̃] = [β_f f̃] = [f α_x] = [f][α_x]. QED.

This is the standard theorem that the homotopy category of C is equivalent to the localization of its full subcategory of cofibrant objects (Quillen; K. S. Brown's categories of (co)fibrant objects). It is part of Grothendieck's 1982 work on 'modelizers' and homotopical algebra preceding Pursuing Stacks. The neighbouring pages are computer printout sheets dated August 1982.
errors: No error in the displayed computation. Gaps: independence of Φ(f) from the choice of factorization ỹ', and full functoriality of Φ, are only sketched in the top diagrams. Ψ needs W_cof ⊂ W, which is implicit. The step 'it suffices to check R ≅ can' tacitly uses the 2-categorical universal property of localization.

ideas.what: Cofibrant replacement induces an equivalence W_cof^{-1}Cof ≃ W^{-1}C. Morphisms are represented as [i_f]^{-1}[f̃], using factorizations through cofibrant objects and 2-out-of-3.
ideas.modern_name: Equivalence of the homotopy category with that of cofibrant objects (Brown's category of cofibrant objects / Quillen model categories)
ideas.usually_credited_to: D. Quillen (Homotopical Algebra, 1967); K. S. Brown (1973)
ideas.where_published: Similar material on modelizers appears in Pursuing Stacks (1983); this exact argument is not identified

ideas.what: Weak equivalences are sent to isomorphisms via 2-out-of-3 applied to β_f f̃ = f α_x.

deep.surprise_reason: A routine, correct verification of a well-known homotopical-algebra lemma (Quillen/Brown). Its only interest is historical: it documents Grothendieck working through model-category basics in 1982, before Pursuing Stacks.
